test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Anjali is designing a wall for a social purpose. She completed 7 over 11 work in 14 days. In how many days will she complete the rest of the work?
solution:
**Given:**

14 days for 7/11 work.

**Solution:**

Work left = 1 - 7/11 = 4/11

For 1/11 work, she took 14/7 = 2 days

So, for 4/11 she will need 4x2 = 8 days

**Hence, she will take 8 more days to finish her work.**
